name: link
summary: Navigation control. Default renders a RouterLink (<a>); as-button renders an MButton that pushes the route on click. Only own prop is asButton; everything else passes through.

variants.name: muted
variants.what: [element] obs-link muted — secondary/subdued link (lighter --neutral-light text, keeps the dotted underline). For a secondary action link like Cancel next to a primary Save.

asButton.note: button-styled navigation (MButton + $router.push) vs a plain RouterLink

k-link.note: [element] obs-link: subtle grid link — neutral text, no underline until hover

muted.note: [element] obs-link: secondary/subdued link — lighter (--neutral-light) text, keeps the dotted underline. Use for a Cancel-style secondary action beside a primary Save.

modes.asButton: MButton -> navigates via $router.push on click (no href)

accessibility.default: real anchor — correct link role + keyboard + new-tab
accessibility.asButton: F1 — a <button>, not an anchor: no href, no middle-click/new-tab, announced as button

decisionFlow: Performs an action (save/delete/change state)? -> Button, not a link.
External URL / opens in a new tab? -> plain <a href target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer> (FlotoLink is internal-only).
Internal navigation that should look like a prominent CTA/button? -> FlotoLink as-button (with a variant).
Inline internal navigation in content / menus / breadcrumbs / a clickable value? -> FlotoLink (text link).
A subtle clickable text inside a table/grid? -> class k-link.

text-link(default).useWhen: inline INTERNAL navigation in content, menus, breadcrumbs, logos, a clickable value
text-link(default).dontUse: for actions (use Button) or external URLs (use a plain anchor)
text-link(default).example: go to <the inventory list>; a breadcrumb segment

as-button.useWhen: a prominent INTERNAL navigation call-to-action that should look like a button
as-button.dontUse: where users expect open-in-new-tab/middle-click (F1 — it's a button, no href)

external-link.useWhen: an external/help/doc URL or anything that opens in a new tab
external-link.must: plain <a href target=_blank> with rel=noopener noreferrer (FlotoLink/RouterLink can't do external; SF-004)

k-link(class).useWhen: subtle clickable text inside a table/grid

text-link.useWhen: Inline INTERNAL navigation that takes the user somewhere via a route — links inside content/prose, menu items, breadcrumb segments, the app logo, or a clickable value that opens a detail view. First-match default of the FlotoLink decision flow once you've ruled out actions and external URLs. Add class="text-primary" so it reads as a link (bare links inherit text color, F2).
text-link.dontUse: Not for actions like save/delete/apply/change-state (use MButton) or for external/new-tab URLs (use a plain <a href target=_blank>, FlotoLink is internal-only). Use as-button instead when the internal nav must look like a prominent CTA, or k-link for subtle in-grid text.
text-link.example: A breadcrumb segment, or 'go to the inventory list' inline in content; the navbar/header/user-menu logo and menu navigation links.

external.useWhen: The destination is an external URL or should open in a new tab — documentation, help, or downloadable files. FlotoLink/RouterLink can't resolve external URLs, so hand-author a plain anchor: <a href target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">. The rel is required (SF-004).
external.dontUse: Don't use FlotoLink here (internal-only, can't resolve external URLs). For internal route navigation use text-link or as-button instead. Never omit rel=noopener noreferrer on a target=_blank link (reverse tabnabbing, SF-004).
external.example: A documentation or help link that opens Motadata docs in a new tab.

k-link.useWhen: A subtle clickable text inside a table/grid that shouldn't shout — neutral --page-text-color with a hover affordance instead of brand color, so it blends into dense grid rows and pagination. Applied as class="k-link" (25× in the app).
k-link.dontUse: Don't use for prominent or standalone inline links (use text-link with text-primary), for CTAs (as-button), or for actions (MButton). Not for external URLs.
k-link.example: A subtle clickable cell value or pagination link inside a data grid.

do: Use for navigation (route/URL): inline links, menus, breadcrumbs, logos.
Use as-button for a prominent navigation CTA; pass a Button variant.
Name the destination in the link text; add text-primary affordance for inline links.
dont: Don't use a link for an action (save/delete/apply) — use a Button.
Don't rely on as-button where open-in-new-tab matters (F1).
whenToUse: Anything that navigates the user somewhere (route, URL, anchor).
insteadOf: a button styled as a link
knownIssues: F1 (medium, a11y/UX): as-button navigates via $router.push on an MButton (no href) — loses middle-click/open-in-new-tab and is announced as a button, not a link. Prefer a real anchor styled as a button for nav CTAs.
F2 (low): plain links inherit text color (no default link color/underline) — a bare link can look like text; most usages add text-primary. Consider a default link style.

F3 (low, security) -> SF-004: FlotoLink is internal-only (RouterLink), so external links are raw <a target=_blank> — 147x across the app, 0 with rel=noopener noreferrer (reverse tabnabbing; browser-mitigated). Add a shared external-link component + lint rule. See findings/SF-004.
changelog: 2026-07-14: as-button now paints ALL obs-button variants (owner, field-report C-item) — it only styled primary/primary-alt/default/transparent, so <obs-link as-button variant="error|success|ghost|danger|dashed|info|neutral|warning|neutral-lighter|neutral-lightest"> rendered unstyled. Mirrored the full obs-button variant set into .as-btn.

2026-07-13: dark-mode muted-hover fix — the muted link hover used --neutral-dark (near-black in dark mode → invisible on hover). Switched to --page-text-color (emphasises correctly in both themes: darker in light, lighter in dark).

2026-07-13: added a `muted` variant to obs-link (secondary/subdued link — lighter --neutral-light text, keeps the dotted underline). Introduced so an inline Save (default) / Cancel (muted) pair in obs-table reads with a proper primary/secondary hierarchy while both stay DS links.

2026-06-07: added (decision-grade from the start). 67x/48 files; RouterLink default + as-button MButton route-push; only own prop asButton. Verified in SB (RouterLink + $router stubbed). F1 (as-button not a real link), F2 (no default affordance). Closes Button's navigation relative.

a11y.summary: True <a>/RouterLink — link role + keyboard focus. Use destination-naming text (not 'click here'); as-button variant announces as a button.
issues: Plain links inherit text colour (F2) — add an affordance.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
